facts.value: Bachelor's degree or a degree of equivalent status in Art History, Philosophy, Ethnology, History, Art Education, Archaeological Sciences, or related cultural studies subjects. Graduates of artistic degree programs can also be admitted.

Proof of knowledge of two foreign languages: English at B2 level and a second modern foreign language at B1 level. For admission to the master's examination at the end of the studies, proof of Latin knowledge or a third modern foreign language at B1 level must be provided.
International students require proof of language proficiency at DSH-1 level.
